corrections_and_exclusions: Guide incorrectly calls nuclear renewable; uranium is non-renewable.

Dryholme retains verified 1 MW and planning estimate about 1,200 homes, not guide 4,000.
Hinkley C is under construction; separate proposed generation from current impacts.
